signal: Workrise rebranded back to RigUp in late 2025, recommitting to its oil and gas workforce roots and its source-to-pay platform for energy.

email.body1:
Zach, saw the rebrand back to RigUp and the recommitment to the oil and gas workforce that built the business.

A repositioning like that usually reopens a wide list of E&P accounts faster than the team can cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for RigUp off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zach, quick follow-up for RigUp.

A relaunch expands the operators worth chasing faster than headcount can ramp, so accounts go untouched and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings the E&P workforce book needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zach, last bit of proof for RigUp.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how RigUp reply rate likely compares to other energy-tech platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zach, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling E&P coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a relaunch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your energy motion? I will tailor it to RigUp either way.
